tools.name: message_read
tools.description: Read an admitted Slack message using its task-authorized trigger ID.

tools.name: thread_read
tools.description: Read the authorized Slack thread. Group history access is required.

setup.description: Install a Slack app in the expected workspace. Grant chat:write, channels:history, groups:history, channels:read, groups:read and users:read as required, and invite it to the selected channels. tokenEnv names a host environment variable; never place the token in this file. Polling and thread replies use the Slack Web API. For complete live delivery including old-thread replies, enable Socket Mode, set appTokenEnv to an app-level token with connections:write, and subscribe to message.channels, message.groups, member_joined_channel, member_left_channel, channel_archive and channel_unarchive. Polling alone is a backfill path, not a complete realtime event feed.

fields.name: token-env
fields.label: Bot token
fields.help: From the Slack app OAuth page. Use a bot token with the listed scopes; never use your personal session token.

fields.name: team-id
fields.label: Workspace ID
fields.help: Copy the expected T… workspace ID. Authentication checks reject a different workspace.

fields.name: channels
fields.label: Channel IDs
fields.help: Invite the bot to each selected channel. Enter C… or G… IDs separated by commas.

fields.name: app-token
fields.label: Socket Mode app token
fields.help: Optional xapp token with connections:write enables live old-thread replies. Without it, polling is backfill only.
